limits: The two related color producers contain 26 charts, including varied per-point appearance; public import and exact HTML-package reopen are checked separately.
No marker pixel equivalence to Calc is claimed.
Calc changes star to square and dot to triangle, drops the size on none, and materializes inherited properties; these changes are recorded rather than treated as source fidelity.
The source normative dash/dot geometry and star/plus/x fills are checked separately in all browser engines.
